chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ḥarīz, from Zurārah, from one of the two of them عليهما السلام, who said:

I said to him: A man does not know whether he has prayed one rakʿah or two. He said: He repeats. He said: I said: A man does not know whether he has prayed two or three. He said: If doubt comes to him after his entering into the third, he proceeds with the third, then he prays the other one, and there is nothing upon him; then he gives salām, and there is nothing upon him.

key_terms.يُسَلِّمُ: he gives the salām ending the prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts whether he prayed two or three rakʿahs in salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on doubt in the number of rakʿahs during salat. If one doubts between one and two, he repeats the prayer; but if he doubts between two and three after entering the third, he continues and completes the prayer without liability.
